$comment: Lumenfold design-system clone of relevanceai.com. ia.json is the only hand-edited IA file; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs. Derived from src/App.jsx, src/pages/*/routes.jsx and the page components they render (built), plus CLONE_SPEC.md and specs/PAGES_*.md (spec-only). chrome axis = build status: "built" (registered in a routes.jsx and rendered), "in-progress" (page component exists but is not registered), "spec-only" (only in a spec). Every route, built or not, renders the same Navbar + Footer shell from App.jsx. Parameterised routes are counted by real slugs in src/content/*.js (company.stories, editorial.posts/guides/notes/events/comparisons, catalog.integrations/useCaseList/workflows/articles). Out of scope, not templates: /academy (external academy.* domain); /templates and /agent-templates-* (external marketplace.* domain, specs PAGES_CATALOG M1-M4); /resources/:slug (seen in passing, not specced); legacy/test pages (-old, -copy, backup-home, untitled-2, abm-test, scratch-pad, unsubscribe, app). Redirects, not templates: /app-tools/:slug -> /integrations; /prompt-engineering -> /learn; /changelog/:entry -> /changelog#entry. implementedBy is set only where the component was read and confirmed rendering in a registered route; several sections have parallel copies in more than one group folder, listed in their implementedBy string.

meta.title: Lumenfold (relevanceai.com DS clone) information architecture
meta.source: Local React/Vite clone at http://localhost:5191 (src/App.jsx + src/pages/*/routes.jsx) and recon specs CLONE_SPEC.md, specs/PAGES_COMPANY.md, specs/PAGES_CONTENT.md, specs/PAGES_CATALOG.md, specs/PAGES_PRODUCT.md

categories.SHELL: Global chrome mounted by App.jsx on every route: header/mega-menu and footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block of a route.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, case studies, testimonials, security and awards.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation modules: tiles, demos, diagrams, comparisons of approach.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive reading content: articles, FAQs, legal text, event and story bodies.
categories.CATALOG: Browsable collections: card grids, filtered lists, related rails.
categories.CONVERSION: Calls to action and forms: grain CTAs, scripted CTAs, demo/contact/apply forms.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 65px top header: Lumenfold logo, primary links that open the mega-menu panels, sign-in and primary CTA buttons; collapses to a hamburger-triggered mobile drawer.
shell.navbar.scope: Mounted once in App.jsx around the router, so every route carries it, including the not-found page and the spec-only templates once they are routed.

shell.footer.description: Site footer: link columns, newsletter/brand block and legal row, rendered below <main>.
shell.footer.scope: Mounted once in App.jsx, so every route carries it; legacy originals that had their own footer (or none) are rebuilt with this one.
